name: Painted in enamels over the fired glaze and fired again at a lower heat (wucai, doucai, falangcai)

roughness.note: An enamel is a coloured glass fired onto the glaze: glossy as it is; its slight relief is not drawn.

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

relief.derivation: no relief is drawn over the work's own image: an enamel stands about a tenth of a millimetre proud, finer than the eye reads at a case's distance
